text: Environmental science and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates environmental science (studying the essence and laws of environmental issues) and engineering technology (practical methods for solving environmental pollution and ecological damage), aiming to achieve the protection, restoration and sustainable utilization of the environment through scientific theories and engineering means. This major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, covering multi-medium environmental issues such as water, air and soil, as well as fields like pollution control, ecological restoration and resource recycling.
